baseline.method: Original qMRLab MTSAT_exec Octave8.4.0, exact bound volumes

definitions.rmse: RMS absolute error on fixed public observation-only mask; percent for reconstruction and s^-1 for r1
definitions.ncc: Flattened cosine, no centering, on same mask
definitions.observation_relative_rmse: L2 predicted-observed / L2 observed for all three FLASH images on mask
definitions.outside_max: Maximum absolute submitted output outside fixed analysis mask

provenance: Independent identical Octave reruns; nonzero numerical tolerances frozen before local extraction; reference agreement not physical truth
